versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation links in SKILL.md to reference the main branch of the OpenClaw Swarm repository.
- Removed the branch reference from the repo link and doc link for clarity and accuracy.

No changes detected in this version.

- Version bumped to 1.0.1 without modifications to files or documentation.

Initial release of openclaw-swarm skill, providing advanced subagent orchestration tools.

- Enables spawning and coordination of multiple subagents with flexible context sharing.
- Offers context_store for reading/writing shared data between subagents.
- Adds context_publish for event-based notifications (e.g., subagent completion).
- Supports parallel_spawn to run subagents concurrently with different wait strategies.
- Includes usage patterns for parallel research, workflow chaining, and context pipelines.
- Features automatic subagent completion announcements (no polling required).
